diagnosis.qualification: All are supplementary frozen-binary same-window diagnoses, not rewritten original baselines or native Linux release qualification. Every warmup and measured sample is retained. Original query args, checksums and metric directions/5% throughput/10% latency/3% MAD/6% central-noise checks retained. CPU affinity applies only to the owned Windows helper/children and is restored; system power policy is only read, not changed.
diagnosis.conclusion: The original e507 vs pre-e507 p95 regression is not reproduced as a median threshold failure in either same-window Windows condition, but both conditions still fail noise checks. Root cause and the original failure remain open; no causal link between duplicate clearing and the earlier p95 regression has been established. Cold-init before/after diagnostics do not replace those failures.

helper_environment_failure: Initial supplementary helper referenced a missing private version function; initial helper/error note retained, then corrected to the runner actual release_identity.tool_version API. Both default environments match the originals. No timed run or production code changed.
